Usage: rhythm-sightread report <report.json>... -o <file>

Renders one or more JSON reports a review saved into another format, by the
extension of each -o file: .md, .html, .sarif or .json. Several reports merge
into one, for example the reports of several CI jobs. It needs no network.

Flags:
  --diff                keep every changed hunk the reports hold
  -o, --output <file>   write the merged report to this file (repeatable; .md,
                        .html, .sarif or .json)
  --redact-paths        show paths relative to the project only (default on when
                        CI is set)

Examples:
  rhythm-sightread report review.json -o review.html
  rhythm-sightread report web.json api.json -o all.md -o all.sarif
